**MyPet 3.15.0 is the final release of MyPet 3.** After more than a decade, MyPet 3 is now complete. This release closes every known duplication exploit, makes Pets respect claims and protected regions, speeds up the plugin across the board, and further prepares your saved Pet data for the move to MyPet 4. There will be no more MyPet 3 updates.

## The future is MyPet 4
MyPet 4 is the biggest update in MyPet's history, rebuilt from the ground up. If you love MyPet 3, you're going to love MyPet 4:

- **Never wait for an update again.** MyPet 4 has no version-specific code, so new Minecraft versions work automatically, usually on day one.
- **Pets are real vanilla mobs.** They save their exact state (armor, stats, variants, everything) and keep their vanilla behaviours.
- **31 skills**, including Mining, Lumberjack, Fishing, Sniff, Potion, Toolbox, Taunt, Armor, Climb, Camouflage and Scale.
- **Custom pet models** included out of the box, plus new Pet types like the Sulfur Cube.
- **Several Pets out at once**, managed from one sortable, filterable roster.
- **A browser-based live editor.** Run `/mypet editor` to edit your configs, shops, skilltrees and translations in your browser, with changes applied live.
- **Rebuilt menus**, led by `/pet`: one screen for everything your Pet can do, with per-Pet volume and follow-distance settings.
- **Folia support**, MiniMessage formatting, Lands and PlaceholderAPI improvements, and an importer that brings pets over from MCPets and SimplePets.

**Moving over is painless.** MyPet 4 migrates your configs, Pets, skilltrees, translations and database automatically on first startup. Every item in your Pets' Backpacks saved by this release carries its Minecraft version, so it comes across exactly as it was. MyPet 4 needs Paper (or Purpur/Folia) on Minecraft 1.20.5 or newer with Java 21. If you're on Spigot, switching is as easy as swapping your server jar.

**Buying MyPet 4 is the best way to support my work.** MyPet is built and maintained by one person and is nearly a full-time job. Every copy of MyPet 4 directly funds its development - the fixes, the new features, and support for each new Minecraft version on day one. If MyPet 3 has been part of your server, MyPet 4 is how you keep that going.

## Changes
- Added a MyPet 4 release notice for servers that can run MyPet 4
- Items in Pet Backpacks and equipment are now saved with the Minecraft version they were written on, so they survive Minecraft updates and the move to MyPet 4
- Faster startup: the update check no longer holds up the server when the network is slow
- Big performance improvements for following, aggressive and farming Pets, translated messages and placeholders, player movement, ProtocolLib and SQLite

## Security fixes
We recommend all servers update. This release closes every known duplication exploit: Pet Backpacks, the Pet switch menu, the pet shop's Confirm button and Copper Golem poppies. Players can no longer take the gear off someone else's horse Pet, capture mobs inside claims, or use `/petshop` and `/petskill` on other players when permissions are turned off.

Pets now respect your protection plugins everywhere. Aggressive Pets leave tamed animals in claims alone, WorldGuard and Lands now protect villagers and golems, the Lightning and Bleed skills follow PvP and region rules, and a protection plugin that errors now blocks Pet damage instead of allowing it.

### Full changelog:
- Added a MyPet 4 release notice at startup, in `/mypet update` and for ops on join, on servers that can run MyPet 4 (Paper, 1.20.5+, Java 21+)
- Items in Pet Backpacks and equipment are now saved with the Minecraft version they were written on (1.16.5+); older saved items load exactly as before
- Improved startup time when the update check can't reach the network
- Improved server performance of following Pets on 1.20 and newer
- Improved server performance with many aggressive or farming Pets near protected areas
- Improved server performance of translated messages and PlaceholderAPI placeholders
- Improved server performance of player movement for Pets without an active Beacon
- Improved server performance with ProtocolLib, and skipped its packet listeners entirely on 1.21.4 and newer (thanks to 1wairesd)
- Improved SQLite pet loading speed and fixed database resources not being released
- Error reporting no longer sends errors thrown by other plugins, by modified MyPet jars, by jars swapped while the server runs or by the host's file system or database
- Fixed MyPet failing to load on Paper 1.20.5 through 1.21.4
- Fixed MyPet stopping with a confusing error instead of a clear message when its support for your Minecraft version can't load; on Minecraft 26.3 and newer, MyPet now points to MyPet 4, which supports it
- Fixed console errors every tick from a Pet whose movement wasn't ready yet
- Fixed errors when hitting a leftover Pet entity that no longer belongs to a Pet
- Fixed the Beacon skill's Health Boost buff filling the console with errors instead of working
- Fixed occasional "Already scheduled" errors when MyPet counted stored Pets
- Fixed false "connection leak" warnings with MySQL on busy servers
- Fixed errors on every right-click when the skilltree control item is set to `none` or can't be loaded; `none` now means an empty hand
- Fixed errors when a leftover Pet entity from a removed Pet was told to attack
- Fixed `/petrelease` failing partway through for hostile Pets on Peaceful servers
- Fixed `/petadmin info item` failing on 1.8 and 1.12 when holding a modded or custom item
- Fixed an item duplication exploit when a Pet's Backpack changed size while it was open
- Fixed a Pet's Backpack losing items in removed rows when it shrank
- Fixed a Pet duplication exploit with the Pet switch menu
- Fixed a Pet being active for two players at once
- Fixed double-clicking Confirm in the pet shop buying the pet twice and charging twice, and the shop's stored-pet limit now being checked at the moment of purchase
- Fixed a poppy duplication exploit with Copper Golem Pets, including Pets that already held a duplicated stack
- Fixed other players being able to shear the saddle, armor or chest off a horse, donkey, mule, llama or camel Pet
- Fixed any player being able to open the pet shop for other players or view their Pet's skills when permissions are disabled
- Fixed players being able to capture mobs inside claims and protected regions
- Fixed mob capture ignoring hits that another plugin had cancelled
- Fixed aggressive Pets attacking tamed wolves and cats inside claims
- Fixed Pets hurting villagers and golems inside WorldGuard regions that deny `damage-animals`, and in Lands claims
- Fixed Pets attacking in protected areas when a protection plugin hook fails; MyPet now logs a warning naming the hook
- Fixed the Lightning skill's splash damage hitting players, Pets and mobs in protected areas or with PvP disabled
- Fixed the Bleed skill damaging players, Pets and mobs in protected areas or with PvP disabled
- Fixed the Bleed skill stacking indefinitely; re-applying it now extends it to at most twice its duration
- Fixed a slow memory leak from mobs that were hurt by Pets but despawned or unloaded instead of dying
- Fixed milking a Goat Pet with a stack of buckets replacing the whole stack with a single milk bucket (thanks to HariBote1110)

Thank you for over a decade of MyPet 3. See you in MyPet 4!
